zh.name: 同一行为换个情境看
zh.summary: 固定一个行为或对象，改变情境或观察立场，呈现为什么会有不同理解。
zh.useWhen: 情境变化是比较轴；期待与实际作为变体，不按题材各算一个。
zh.instructions: 同一行为、两种情境、对应图像与可解释差别
zh.output: 一组保留本模板风格、叙事与钩子的 Instagram 图文。

en.name: Context Comparison Opinion
en.summary: Create an Instagram opinion carousel using the context comparison opinion structure. Preserve its visual hierarchy, sequence and opening payoff.
en.useWhen: Use when your content needs the context comparison opinion format.
en.instructions: Provide your topic, audience, usable source material and confirmed facts.
en.output: An editable Instagram carousel with this template’s sequence and visual style.
